evidence.note: Sanitary demolition campaign in the arrabal: 'begun on June 21, 1909, when the Health Office ordered 152 houses and shacks in the district of Guachapali to be destroyed. evidence.name: Cartagenita
evidence.source: The Canal Record (official weekly)
evidence.reference: Canal Record Vol IV v00004/p454 (Page A-409)
evidence.note: Origin story in the official organ: when the French began work at the Pacific entrance 'they imported a number of Colombian laborers from Cartagena, who settled the place under the name of Cartagenita (Little Cartagena).
